summary: One-line change correctly propagates the `multi_class` option into the `LogisticRegression` instance used for scoring, so probabilistic scorers (e.g. neg_log_loss) now use softmax probabilities for multinomial as intended. Minimal, correct fix that directly resolves the reported bug.

issues.description: Fix addresses the predict_proba/scoring path but the surrounding `if multi_class == 'ovr':` branch and coef handling are untouched; for the common multinomial case this is correct, though a maintainer might want to confirm the multinomial branch's classes_/coef shaping is fully consistent. Not merge-blocking.
